## Project: Tabelline Quiz with Voice Recognition

This is an ASP.NET Core Blazor Server application for an interactive multiplication tables (tabelline) quiz with the following features:

### Core Features
- Interactive multiplication quiz with voice recognition support using Web Speech API
- Advanced statistics tracking (accuracy, speed, streak analysis)
- Gamification with achievements and scoring system
- Modern responsive UI with Bootstrap styling
- Real-time feedback and progress tracking

### Technical Stack
- ASP.NET Core 9.0+
- Blazor Server
- Bootstrap 5 for styling
- JavaScript integration for Web Speech API
- SignalR for real-time updates

### Development Guidelines
- Follow Blazor component patterns
- Use clean separation between UI and business logic
- Implement proper error handling for voice recognition
- Ensure responsive design for all screen sizes
- Maintain accessibility standards

### Project Structure
- `/Components` - Blazor components
- `/Services` - Business logic and game engine
- `/Models` - Data models and statistics
- `/wwwroot` - Static files, CSS, JavaScript
